tp.Liability_critical: Unlimited liability poses an existential operational risk. An industry-standard liability cap protects both business entities.
tp.Liability_high: Capping liability at the total contract value is the standard legal framework for balanced risk distribution.
tp.NonCompete_high: An excessive non-compete duration unfairly restricts professional livelihood; reducing the scope balances both parties' interests.
tp.default: The suggested adjustment aligns with standard commercial practices, ensuring a balanced and fair contractual relationship.
